Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Cherry Hill for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Haddonfield tree lighting and Holiday House at Barclay Farmstead) through December 6 (the Winter Festival at Croft Farm), with Deck the Dell in Haddon Heights (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Cherry Hill

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Cherry Hill and nearby Haddonfield and Haddon Heights
  • 2 free events: the Haddonfield Tree Lighting, Santa Parade and Cocoa Walk, and the Winter Festival at Croft Farm
  • Meet Santa: Holiday House at Barclay Farmstead (November 28 and December 5) and the Haddonfield Santa parade (November 27)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Haddonfield Tree Lighting and Santa Parade (November 27)
  • Season: November 27 to December 6
